_comment: Ink 2026-11-11 ONBOARDING-P1 revision of res://data/tutorial/first_session_1936.json (as shipped in #183 / main 5e24dd34+). Same schema; drop-in for the shipped file. All 12 ids, n, kind, trigger and complete predicates are unchanged, and all 12 titles are unchanged (HeadlessTutorial1Test._test_json_copy pins them). Copy changed on steps 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 (+ step 10 status/keys/done copy). Keys starting with p1_ are optional hints for Ship; the shipped TutorialGuideDomain ignores unknown keys, so this file is safe to drop in before any code change. Body copy is written to fit the card's 4-line body cap (Label.max_lines_visible = 4 at 14 px, ~348 px wrap). P1 OP decisions 2026-11-11: split P1a (this file, card, guide) / P1b (MainMenu + Tutorial naming); step 10 completes only on a player-started battle (battle_started_player now means attacker_tag == player); under-attack hint keeps step 10 open.

p1_paused_button.tooltip: Start the tutorial again from step 1 on this map. Your game, units and date stay as they are.

confirm.title: Tutorial
confirm.text: Restart the tutorial on this map? Your game keeps running as is.

steps.title: You lead Germany, 1936
steps.body: The map opens on Germany, your country. The game is paused. This short guide shows the basics. Skip it any time.

steps.title: Time is paused
steps.body: Nothing moves until you start the clock. Press Space to run time, and 1–4 to pick a speed. Watch the date change, then press Space again to pause.
steps.status: Waiting for you: run 1 day, then pause

steps.title: See the map another way
steps.body: Map modes recolour the map. Press F5 for supply or F6 for loyalty. F1 brings back the political map.
steps.status: Waiting for you: switch map mode
steps.done_title: F1 brings you back to Political

steps.title: Look at a province
steps.body: Click any province on the map. The inspector on the left shows its owner, factories and terrain. Close shuts it.
steps.status: Waiting for you: click a province

steps.title: Meet your divisions
steps.body: The boxed counters on the map are your divisions. Click the counter itself, not the land around it, to open its card. Fill% is equipment on hand, not strength.
steps.status: Waiting for you: open a division card
steps.p1_note: Removed the 'U' key chip: U toggles unit counters off (MapRenderer KEY_U → toggle_unit_counters), it does not open a card.

steps.title: Wars need a reason first
steps.body: You are at peace. To attack Poland you first justify a war. Press Justify war on Poland in the inspector. Dipl in the top bar has the same button.
steps.body_no_inspector: You are at peace. To attack Poland you first justify a war. Click a Polish province to open the inspector, or use Dipl in the top bar.
steps.status: Waiting for you: start a justification
steps.p1_note: Only ring BtnDeclareWar when the inspector is on a province of the target (inspector_on_target). Otherwise ring Dipl. Fixes the stale 'Justify war on Austria' spotlight from Play r1.

steps.title: Let the claim build
steps.body: Justifying takes 14 days. Unpause and let the clock run. The guide pauses the game for you when it is ready.
steps._pause_note: Uses the clock owner public pause()/is_paused(). No private calls.

steps.title: Your claim is ready
steps.body: The guide paused the game. Click a Polish province and press Declare war on Poland, or use Dipl. Declaring does not move troops.
steps.done_body: Good. Declaring changes nothing on the map by itself. Your divisions wait for your orders.

steps.title: Move an army
steps.body: Click one of your divisions, press March…, then click one of your own provinces on the border with Poland. Unpause so it walks. Esc cancels.
steps.status: Waiting for you: give a march order

steps.title: Start a fight
steps.body: Pick a division on the border with Poland (zoom in if none show). Press Open fight on its card, or Ctrl+click an enemy province next to it. Then press Start battle.
steps.status: Waiting for you: press Start battle
steps.done_body: Your division fights at Press by default. Switch to Hold or Withdraw on its unit card any time.
steps.p1_note: OP (e): completes ONLY on a battle Germany starts: battle_started with attacker_tag == player, an open land battle with att_tag == player, or the player assault cue (order_attack). AI-started battles (player is def_tag) do not complete it; they switch the status line to the under-attack hint and the step stays open. Stance is taught on the 3 s done card (OP (c)).

p1_hint_under_attack.status: You're under attack; now start your own battle

p1_target.source: FirstSessionGuide._unit_adjacent (first GER formation whose province touches target-owned land)
p1_target.screen_rect: MapRenderer node get_global_transform_with_canvas() * MapManager.get_province_centroid(pid), box 56x56 min 40 (read-only calls, no MapRenderer.gd edit)

steps.title: Save your game
steps.body: Press Ctrl+S to quicksave now. Ctrl+Shift+S opens the save list. Ctrl+L loads your quicksave.

target.note: SaveButton/LoadButton nodes exist in TopInfoBar.tscn MenuContainer but the live bar shows a single Menu

steps.title: How the campaign ends
steps.body: If Germany capitulates, it is Defeat. Beat two major powers for Victory. Otherwise it ends on 1 January 1949: the top industry is Ascendant, the rest are Eclipsed.
steps.p1_note: Dropped the 'Ctrl+S save' chip: step 11 just taught saving, and a lone chip on the final card read as an instruction to press it again.
